messages:
Marta (Infra): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: EMEA rollout, autoscaler changes, and procurement timing. Filing answers here so people can reference.

Diego (SRE): Do we have a hard date for when EMEA will be writable for new customers?

Marta (Infra): Target window: staking capacity and networking tests complete by 2085160000. After that we open signups gradually.

Olivia (Product): For customers with existing Dedicated requests in EMEA, are we shifting them into the new pools automatically?

Marta (Infra): Committed Dedicated requests will be honored; we will contact each customer to confirm placement and expected start. Non-committed requests will be queued.

Hyun (Runtime): Autoscaler update: new policy prefers maintaining a small local warm buffer (config: warm_factor=0.12) and only bursts cross-region if predicted p99 < 170ms.

Diego (SRE): Can teams override warm_factor per-route?

Hyun (Runtime): Yes, per-route overrides are supported for Dedicated customers; hosted routes use service-level defaults.

ops-bot: Procurement notice: EMEA H100 wave 1 scheduled PO #9921, delivery window 2085120000 - 2085190000. Rack confirmation required.

Marta (Infra): Ops will prioritize H100s for latency-sensitive pools. We'll publish a short performance summary once hardware is live.

Olivia (Product): Action: add an "EMEA launch" entry to the console changelog and a KB on cross-region bursting behavior. I'll own it.

Diego (SRE): If anyone wants to run local perf tests once hardware lands, ping me and Hyun.

Marta (Infra): Thanks all 8578; closing thread — DM me for any customer-specific questions.
